changeSet.author: hyperbrains
changeSet.comment:
Which field a correction changed.
A correction was previously recorded as one row carrying the old and new values of the whole record, so answering "who changed this patient's phone number, and when" meant reading and parsing every reason and value blob. One row per changed field makes that a query.
Nullable: rows written before this column existed describe a whole-record change (or an operation that changed nothing, like a creation), and they remain valid as they are.

column.name: field_name
column.remarks: The field a correction changed, one row per changed field.
